plans.name: AssemblyAI
plans.plan: Universal-3.5 Pro · Pay as you go
plans.trainingNote: Paid accounts can request a training opt-out by email. It applies only after confirmation, not retroactively. The policy says opting out forfeits model-improvement discounts; the resulting account rate needs confirmation.
plans.priceNote: Published base rate; speaker labels add $0.02 per audio hour. A no-training configuration may change the price.
plans.next: Obtain opt-out confirmation and the applicable rate before sending any customer recordings.

plans.name: Deepgram
plans.plan: Nova-3 monolingual · Pay as you go
plans.trainingNote: Deepgram documents a model-training exclusion using mip_opt_out=true on every relevant API request. Recall has not verified the applicable no-training price or your account configuration.
plans.priceNote: $0.0043 per minute converts to $0.258 per hour. The exact cost with privacy settings or speaker labels needs confirmation.
plans.next: Confirm the price for your configuration and ensure every request excludes model training before processing customer audio.

plans.name: Gladia
plans.trainingNote: Gladia’s plan guide documents automatic training opt-out on Growth. Its integration guide states customer data on Growth is not used for model training.
plans.priceNote: Advertised from $0.20 per hour, with upfront usage commitment. The minimum commitment and your actual rate are not established here; this is not a monthly quote.
plans.next: Confirm the upfront commitment, actual rate and no-training terms in the order before purchasing.

plans.name: Gladia
plans.trainingNote: Gladia’s integration guide says Starter audio may be used for training by default. A general privacy statement is not evidence that this specific configuration meets a no-training requirement.
plans.priceNote: $0.61 per audio hour, with speaker labels included. Growth is a separate committed-usage plan, not this rate with a privacy switch.
plans.next: If no training is required, investigate Growth or obtain a written exception; do not treat Starter as meeting that condition.

plans.name: Speechmatics
plans.trainingNote: The pricing FAQ says the model-training programme is off by default. Without opting in, audio and transcripts are not used to improve models. Batch data is deleted after seven days or earlier through the API; no training does not mean no retention.
plans.priceNote: $0.45 per audio hour with both the training and volume-discount switches off. Speaker labels are included. The headline $0.24 Standard rate has discounts enabled. This estimate excludes the automatic 20% discount on usage above 500 hours per month and any free credits.
plans.next: Keep Model Training disabled and confirm Batch Standard in your account. Check retention settings before uploading customer recordings.

plans.name: Soniox
plans.estimateNote: Approximate hourly equivalent · billed by tokens
plans.trainingNote: Soniox’s API data policy says audio and transcripts are not used to improve its models or services. Async files and transcripts can be stored for processing and retrieval, then are automatically deleted after 30 days or earlier through the API.
plans.priceNote: About $0.10 per audio hour is an illustrative equivalent, not a fixed hourly tariff. Async audio costs $1.50 per million input tokens; input and output text cost $3.50 per million tokens. Actual speech density, output and context affect the bill. Speaker labels have no separate surcharge.
plans.next: Test a representative non-sensitive recording and check actual token usage. Confirm projected spend and the Async API retention settings before committing.

plans.name: Amazon Transcribe
plans.trainingNote: AWS says Transcribe may use voice inputs to improve and train its AI technologies. An AWS Organizations AI-services opt-out policy can exclude this use. A standard account must not be treated as no-training until that policy is effective.
plans.priceNote: The current US East (N. Virginia) batch example lists $0.006 per minute, or $0.36 per hour, with one-second billing and no minimum. Speaker labels are included. Other regions, storage, optional redaction, custom language models and other AWS services may cost more. Confirm the account configuration for a no-training requirement.
plans.next: Apply and verify the AWS Organizations AI-services opt-out for the processing account, select the intended region, and include storage and any other AWS charges in your budget.
